advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Avoid the double read (or reconcile it) so a live-link ticket that passes _has_live_replacement_link cannot produce a None verdict from a redundant second read.
evidence: close_disposition.py verdict: `replacement = find_replacement(...) ; if replacement is None: return None`
close_disposition.py find_replacement fail-closed branches: `except Exception: ... return None` on both reduce_ticket and find_inbound_relationships
advisory.finding: On the disposition happy path the precheck reads the replacement link twice: _has_live_replacement_link returns True, then verdict()->find_replacement() re-reads reduce_ticket/find_inbound_relationships and returns None on any fail-closed exception; a transient read failure (or state change) between the two reads yields verdict==None -> precheck returns None -> unsigned close, which is exactly bug 738a for a ticket that already passed the guard.
advisory.suggested_fix: Resolve the replacement id once (return it from _has_live_replacement_link, or pass the reduced state into verdict) so the disposition branch uses a single read and cannot fall back to unsigned when the guard already passed.
